GTF engine aftermarket recovery provides a second leg of earnings leverage.

Meanwhile, the hedging on Financials (P/C of 5.56!), Healthcare, and Consumer Staples is massive and coordinated — Financials likely reflect anxiety about credit stress and the widening credit spreads (HYG getting hammered confirms this), Healthcare is bracing for drug pricing executive orders and Medicare negotiation expansion, and Staples weakness suggests worries about tariff pass-through costs squeezing margins on everyday goods. The Tech bearishness is the eyebrow-raiser since the headlines are all AI euphoria, but smart money is buying downside protection at 4.7x normal volume, suggesting they think the trade is crowded or that export controls on China could escalate.
